fusions.name: Roll Flat
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 5 tiles away, then stamps on it for 16 damage, leaving it 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds and stunned for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Pile Driver
fusions.desc: Brings your full weight down, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. It ignores armour.

fusions.name: Planted Anvil
fusions.desc: For 9 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it. You move 15% faster for 4 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Level Ground
fusions.desc: On paved ground, you deal 12% more damage.
